items.title: Browns troll Tomlin with a Minecraft 'game over.' screen
items.summary: Hours after beating the Steelers 27-24 on Thursday Night Football, the Cleveland Browns posted 'game over.' with a Minecraft death screen that offered 'Respawn in Pittsburgh' or 'Generate new world'. It was a dig at ex-Steelers coach Mike Tomlin, who had revealed his 12-year Minecraft city a day earlier and had said 'The Browns is the Browns' earlier in the season. Fans called it a perfect troll, and ESPN listed it among the week's best.
items.author: @Browns

items.title: 'I found your entire childhood on this camera I bought on eBay'
items.summary: New York musician Ben Coleman found old home movies on a used camera he bought on eBay and posted a Reel asking an 'Abby/Abigail from Utah' to DM him for the tape. The Reel passed 3.9 million views in two days. The family found it and commented, and even eBay's official account joined in.
items.author: @bentcoleman
